# commercetools_integration_layer_field_visibility (Resource)

The custom fields and product attributes the Commerce Integration Layer leaves out of its public Experience API schema.

A Project has one set of hidden fields, so define this resource once per Project. The set replaces whatever was hidden before, including fields hidden in the Merchant Center. Every change republishes the schema. When the republish fails the fields are stored but still public: the apply then fails, and the next apply retries it. Destroying the resource makes every field public again.

A field can be hidden before it exists, so a rule can be applied ahead of the type that adds it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_integration_layer_field_visibility" "visibility" {
  hidden_field {
    space      = "customField"
    type_key   = "order-extra"
    field_name = "costPrice"
  }

  hidden_field {
    space      = "attribute"
    type_key   = "chair"
    field_name = "supplierCode"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hidden_field` (Block Set) A field to hide. At most 500. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--hidden_field))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The key of the Project the rules belong to.

<a id="nestedblock--hidden_field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hidden_field`

Required:

- `field_name` (String) Name of the field or attribute.
- `space` (String) `customField` for a field of a Custom Type, `attribute` for an attribute of a Product Type.
- `type_key` (String) Key of the Custom Type or Product Type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The hidden fields are a singleton per Project, so they are imported using
# the Project key. Fields hidden in the Merchant Center are imported too.
terraform import commercetools_integration_layer_field_visibility.visibility my-project-key
```
